mapper.select: SELECT m.MEMBER_NAME AS lmsProfessorProfileName, m.ROLE AS lmsProfessorProfileRole, u.UNIV_NAME AS lmsProfessorProfileUniversityName, m.LOGIN_ID AS lmsProfessorProfileEmployeeNo, d.DEPT_NAME AS lmsProfessorProfileDepartment, m.PHONE_NUMBER AS lmsProfessorProfilePhoneNumber, lp.LMS_PRF_EMAIL AS lmsProfessorProfileEmail, lp.LMS_PRF_INTRO AS lmsProfessorProfileIntroduction, (SELECT lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_ORG_URL FROM LMS_PROFILE_IMAGE lpi WHERE lpi.LMS_PRF_ID = lp.LMS_PRF_ID AND lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_VAL_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_REG_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS lmsProfessorProfileImageUrl FROM LMS_PROFILE lp JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = lp.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN UNIVERSITY u ON u.UNIV_ID = m.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL md ON md.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPT_ID = md.DEPT_ID WHERE lp.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE LMS_PROFILE_IMAGE SET LMS_PRF_IMG_VAL_STATUS = 0 WHERE LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsProfessorProfileId} AND LMS_PRF_IMG_VAL_STATUS = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LMS_PROFILE_IMAGE ( LMS_PRF_IMG_ID, LMS_PRF_ID, LMS_PRF_IMG_REG_DATE, LMS_PRF_IMG_ORG_FIL_NAME, LMS_PRF_IMG_TRN_FIL_NAME, LMS_PRF_IMG_ORG_URL, LMS_PRF_IMG_EXT_TYPE, LMS_PRF_IMG_VAL_STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_LMS_PROFILE_IMAGE.NEXTVAL, #{lmsPrfId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{orgFileName}, #{trnFileName}, #{orgUrl}, #{extType}, 1 )
